decision.explanation: Both organizations are explicitly supported by the source text as employers of Jean Gaudart. Document 1 (D1) repeatedly confirms his employment and affiliation with 'Aix-Marseille University' (e.g., D1S2, D1S3, D1S9). Document 2 (D2) describes a narrative where Jean Gaudart worked at the 'National Center for Atmospheric Research' (NCAR), confirmed by the NCAR logo on a volume (D2S6) and the archivist stating 'Jean was one of our own' (D2S25). The prompt instructions require preserving distinct valid referents and not collapsing multi-answer questions, so both employers are retained.
